_comment: ADR-0004 demonstrator: a property that holds ONLY because of an environmental assumption. PA is provable iff the assume cell A1 is honored. yosys-sat ignores assume cells (legacy `sat`), so it reports PA FALSIFIED; the sby + Bitwuzla backend honors the assume, so PA is PROVEN. Same property, two backends — the honest difference the sby backend buys (temporal safety, sequential equivalence, and AXI-lite all rely on this).

properties.rationale: An environmental constraint on the DUT's input.

properties.summary: enable is high (true only under assumption A1)
properties.rationale: Trivially entailed by A1 — so it PROVES iff the assume is honored, and is FALSIFIED if the backend ignores assumes (ADR-0004).
